original_record.question:
Martina draws the six cornerpoints of a regular hexagon and then connects some of them to obtain a geometric figure. Which of the following figures cannot be generated?

original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.arrangement: regular hexagon with top and bottom vertices

audit.layout_only: Frozen scale and placement; no new visible labels, edges or conditions added.

answer_verification.reason: An inscribed square needs successive central gaps of 90 degrees, unavailable among vertices spaced by 60 degrees. Trapezium, right triangle (diameter endpoints), kite, and obtuse triangle are possible.

self_review.facts: Six unconnected black dots on upright regular hexagon; no extra labels, no clipping.
